annotations.title: Who plays what: population by race, class, faction and level

description: How many characters play each race, class, race and class, faction and level band on WoW: Forever, from the census of players who turned it on in the Everloot addon. Each character counts once. A count shows only when it covers at least 10 characters reported by at least 3 installs from at least 3 addresses, rounded to the nearest 5, and a count that could be worked out from the others is hidden too. Every answer states its window: active in the last 7 days (default) or since launch. With no arguments, the overview: most played class first. No names, ever. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.

race.description: A race, such as Gnome, Night Elf or Undead.

window.description: week: active in the last 7 days. launch: seen since launch.

name: population

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

count.description: Characters, rounded to the nearest 5. Null is hidden: fewer than 10 characters, fewer than 3 installs or fewer than 3 addresses, or hidden so a small count can't be worked out from the others.

race.description: UnitRace's token, such as Scourge for Undead.

share.description: count out of the window's characters, both as shown.

collecting.description: True until the window has 10 characters from 3 installs and 3 addresses; no count shows until then.

installs.description: Installs that reported in the window: a count of installs, not of people.

launched.description: False before launch: nothing is counted yet.

note.description: Why there are no cells: a name the game does not have, or a combination it does not allow.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.
